cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate: C1 - defining anionic Sodium Laureth Sulfate @2 with prominent buffer Cocamidopropyl Betaine @4 and no reinforcing route; Coco-Glucoside @13 is after Parfum and not counted.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate: several light routes - protein films (Hydrolyzed Silk @6, Sericin @7), refatters (Glycosphingolipids @5, PEG-7 Glyceryl Cocoate @9, Glyceryl Oleate @15), one cationic Polyquaternium-10 @10, pearlizer @17 and late lipids (Hydrogenated Castor Oil @18, Apricot Oil @21). C2 not met (no early silicone or prominent payload lipid, no listed humectant). Counter-signal: only proteins and a lipid-like refatter are prominent; neighbor low.

weightPotential.rationale: Moderate: interacting light routes - a cationic Polyquaternium-10, protein films, several refatters and two post-line lipids (one waxy) - plausibly leave bounded residue against a moderate C1 reset.
weightPotential.counterevidence: Every non-protein route is after Parfum @8; the lipids are non-material under W-LINE and PQ-10 is a single light polymer; the SLES/betaine reset is effective.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: Four deposition families converge (cationic_polymer, protein_film, weak_refatter, payload_lipid incl. waxy Hydrogenated Castor Oil); calling the product lightweight would understate the combined residue risk (W2).
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not low: W2 - four families including a cationic polymer and a waxy lipid; no single family is decisive but their combination is not clearly below noticeable. Not high: no material payload lipid (both lipids after the W-line @8), so no W-RICH and no lipid leg for convergence; PQ-10 plus light protein films do not form a persistent coating system against the C1 reset.
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: Low/moderate boundary; amounts of the post-Parfum routes unknown.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: Not targeted (formula half fails, so no claim can make it targeted): no listed comfort or humectant/refatting route is prominent (PEG-7 Glyceryl Cocoate @9 is after Parfum @8) and MB fails (prominent SLES @2); prominent unlisted candidate Glycosphingolipids @5 does not count (closed lists, R18). An explicitly positioned product would still be not_targeted and fail its S-SENSITIVE/S-DRY gate (S-FAIL).
